text:
emily_sales: Heads-up — MediCore (health-tech payer) opened a presales request. Requirements: SAML SSO (Okta/Azure), SCIM provisioning with delta/bulk for ~200k directory objects, delegated admin across subdomains, RBAC mapping to 10 roles, and option for private VPC connector (they asked about air-gapped node). Want a 2-week POC and an estimate for Dedicated + connector + compliance work. Any hard blockers?
marcos_se: High level: doable but need to call out a few items. 1) SCIM over mTLS is only supported on Private deployments; hosted uses token-based SCIM. 2) 200k objects + frequent deltas -> recommend Dedicated for throughput or use SCIM bulk endpoints with change tokens. 3) delegated admin across domains needs canonical domain ownership proof (we require DNS TXT or SAML assertion depending on flow).
emily_sales: They asked if we'd accept SCIM service accounts with limited scope, or if full write perms are mandatory for provisioning sync.
marcos_se: Full write required for create/patch/delete in the POC. You can scope to specific attributes but service account needs write on Users/Groups.
rachel_infosec: From security/compliance: PHI caution — we must not ingest PHI in logs. Legal will need BAA before any PII/PHI enters our systems. Also ask them if they'll require KMS inside their VPC; we support BYOK + customer KMS for Private. Also need pen-test report + SOC2.
emily_sales: Noted. I'll push for tenant counts, change-rate (deltas/min), and whether they want BYOK. They mentioned 200k objects and ~5k changes/day.
tony_soleng: For RBAC mapping we'll use group->role CSV. Example CSV header we ask for: group_external_id,group_name,assigned_role
Sample rows:
"billing-admins","Billing Admins","billing_admin"
"clin-viewers","Clinical Viewers","clinical_viewer"
Also we'll need sample SAML metadata. ACS URL for POC can be `https://poc.medicore.redwood.example/saml/acs`. RelayState supported.
emily_sales: Any notes on certificate rotation? They want 0-downtime swaps.
marcos_se: We support overlapping cert windows for SAML. Upload new cert, mark active start timestamp; old cert remains valid during overlap. Document this in the questionnaire response.
marcos_se: Another presales caveat: if they want SCIM delta polling < 1m we need Dedicated and possibly rate-limit exemptions. Hosted has burst protection.
rachel_infosec: For the questionnaire answer about key handling: draft language -> "Customer-managed KMS is supported in Private and Dedicated with BYOK. Keys remain in customer KMS and we use envelope encryption; when a customer requests key deletion, key material is not retained by Redwood." Approve?
emily_sales: Yes, send that. Also they asked about audit log shipping and immutability.
rachel_infosec: We can forward logs to their Splunk/Syslog/S3. For immutability/WORM require S3 Object Lock or their SIEM to enforce. We'll note that in the response and add legal to loop.
infra-bot: ticket RED-36100 created for MediCore POC (owner: marcos_se) — https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-36100
emily_sales: Cost ask: they want a firm POC estimate for budget approval. Marcos do you have a ballpark for 2-week POC (Dedicated staging + connector + support)?
marcos_se: Ballpark: Dedicated staging (prorated) $12k, connector + installer $9k, eng support & runbooks $6k -> total ~$27k. If they require air-gapped on-prem inference nodes add ~$35k.
tony_soleng: I'll prepare a minimal config checklist for the POC: 1) IdP SAML metadata, 2) SCIM service account JSON + mTLS cert (if Private), 3) RBAC mapping CSV, 4) domain verification access (DNS/email), 5) target network allowlist + proxy details, 6) KMS details + signed BAA.
emily_sales: Great. I'll ask MediCore to confirm the 5k/day change estimate and whether they'll accept staged cert rotation. Will post replies here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
